description: Source code for FPGA driver for Zynq UltraScale+ MPSoC in Zephyr RTOS, including functions for FPGA power management, bitstream parsing, FPGA reset, load, status, and info retrieval.

methods.name: power_up_fpga
methods.description: Power up FPGA by setting power control registers.

methods.name: update_part_name
methods.description: Update FPGA part name based on IDCODE.

methods.name: parse_header
methods.description: Parse FPGA bitstream header to extract design info and raw data.

methods.name: wait_for_done
methods.description: Wait for FPGA configuration to complete.

methods.name: zynqmp_fpga_init
methods.description: Initialize FPGA device, enable clock, and update part info.
